description: We are STEM students from Egypt passionate about space exploration, science, sustainability, and creative problem-solving. With my team, ANA.NASA⁴, we're developing Beyond Earth, an interactive website and mission simulator to help students explore the Moon and Mars. We're looking for creative, curious teammates interested in web development, game development, astronomy, scientific research, and UI/UX design. No expert experience is required—just passion, commitment, and a willingness to learn!
